cases.name: Kerri Ann Fidalgo
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She grew up with her three sisters and a loving extended family. Kerri was a “people person” from a very young age, making friends wherever she went. Upon her high school graduation, Kerri went on to Nichols college where she received a bachelor’s degree in business administration. She put her skills to work helping people in her community as a trusted and respected staff member at the New Bedford 3rd District Court. 

Kerri will be remembered for her huge heart, happy-go-lucky personality, and her smile that could light up any room. Always full of life, she loved travel, tattoos, and entertaining friends and family through hosting parties. Kerri was a huge “foodie” and enjoyed the beach. Daytona Beach, FL was a special place for her, where she cherished the tranquility and beauty of the ocean. Above all, she loved spending time with those most important to her, her family and friends. She was loved by many and will be missed more than words can ever say."
